paragraphs.text: Alchemy: Bloomburrow is a MTG Arena -exclusive card set in the Alchemy -series that was released on August 20, 2024.

Alchemy: Bloomburrow is a digital only release adjacent to the release of Bloomburrow . There are thirty new designed-for-digital cards included in the set (10 uncommons, 15 rares, 5 mythic rares) . All of the cards are set on Bloomburrow .

The digital-only mechanics Boon , Conjure , Draft , Intensity , Not the starting player , Perpetually , Seek and Spellbook are reused. From the main set Forage , Gift , Offspring , Threshold and Valiant are reused. Other featured mechanics are Battle cry , Convoke and Kicker .

paragraphs.text: The Alchemy: Bloomburrow Into the Future event was held on Magic: The Gathering Arena from August 20 to 22, 2024. It featured five phantom preconstructed decks intended to highlight how new cards could be used in the Alchemy format.
